## Bio

Cesar Dao is a student at the University of Texas currently residing in Austin, TX. He is a 
fourth-year Statistics and Data Science student on the Pre-Med track, who plans on pursuing an 
MD after completing his undergraduate studies. Cesar enjoys learning about ways to use 
machine-learning modules and AI to help evaluate medical conditions in order to eliminate
any significant human errors.

Fun Facts:

- Die-hard sports fan (FC Barcelona and Boston Teams)
- Very experienced skier
- Loves Spanish Food and Culture
